content.short: TON Multisender is a utility tool for sending TON or Jettons to multiple addresses simultaneously in one transaction.
content.description: TON Multisender is a highly efficient utility tool designed for the TON blockchain that allows users to distribute Toncoin or Jettons to hundreds of addresses in a single, automated transaction. This tool is essential for project owners conducting airdrops, businesses managing payroll, or anyone needing to perform bulk transfers with minimal effort and lower gas costs. By providing a simple CSV upload feature and a secure interface, TON Multisender streamlines the process of multi-address distribution while ensuring transaction accuracy across the network.
content.meta: Perform bulk transfers on TON with TON Multisender. Send to multiple addresses in one click, featured on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
